summary:
丹納赫最新季度財報優於預期，營收年增長穩健，顯示生命科學與診斷業務持續復甦。
• EPS 達 1.94 美元，優於市場預期的 1.84 美元
• 季度營收達 62.6 億美元，年增 5.54%
• 生命科學與診斷部門需求呈現穩定復甦態勢
• 營運利潤率維持健康水準
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報展現穩健的獲利能力與優於預期的營收表現，釋出醫療保健需求回溫的正面訊號。短中期而言，有利於支撐高評價水準並提振市場信心。後續應持續追蹤生技融資動能、核心營收成長率及利潤率變化。

需留意：高估值（本益比近 36 倍）對宏觀經濟與業績波動較為敏感；生物製藥融資環境與終端需求復甦速度仍具不確定性

summary_en:
Danaher reported stronger-than-expected quarterly results with solid YoY revenue growth, indicating ongoing recovery in life sciences and diagnostics.
• EPS of $1.94 beat consensus estimate of $1.84
• Quarterly revenue reached $6.26B, up 5.54% YoY
• Stable demand recovery observed in life sciences and diagnostics segments
• Operating profit margins remained at healthy levels

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings report demonstrates solid profitability and better-than-expected revenue, signaling a rebound in healthcare demand. In the near to medium term, this supports the premium valuation and boosts market confidence. Key metrics to track include biopharma funding momentum, core revenue growth rate, and margin trends.

Watch：High valuation (trailing P/E near 36x) leaves little room for macroeconomic or operational setbacks; Uncertainty remains regarding the pace of recovery in biopharma funding and end-market demand
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 1.94 美元高於預期的 1.84 美元，主要受惠於核心業務回穩。
